profile.headline: Software Developer at NISC | CIPP/E | CIPM | GRCP
profile.summary: I am currently working as a software developer at NISC. I graduated from Indiana University and I studied informatics with a cognate in business. I also worked as a technical implementation consultant at OneTrust.

positions.title: Technical Implementation Consultant
positions.description:
• Manage technical implementation projects from start to finish and lead functional and technical workshops for all clients
• Provide implementation recommendations to clients with an understanding of their technical and business needs 
• Troubleshoot client technical issues with knowledge of different tag managers, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS

positions.title: Technology Product Manager
positions.description:
•	Directed the project of developing websites by focusing on UX design and building a database by creating ERD model 
•	Collaborated with UX design team and constructed a company website with HTML, CSS, and Javascript

positions.title: Team Lead-Website Development Team
positions.description:
•	Led weekly team meeting for a group of 12 interns to develop new technical skills and to ensure tasks are well processed 
•	Discussed technical issues with non-profit organization representatives and consulted new technical support 
•	Consulted non-profit organizations for building new websites and databases using Bootstrap, PHP, MySQL, and JQuery 
•	Built a website and databases for MarkIT, a webpage for all local farmers to stay connected and advertise their farms

positions.title: Intern - Information Strategy Team
positions.description:
•	Operated SQL database management in the process of transformation of ERP to concatenate SAP software with a team 
•	Acquired knowledge of data migration from in-house ERP to SAP for an automotive component manufacturing company

positions.title: Activity Coordinator - Global Engagement Team
positions.description:
•	Organized various events for the college and managed $5000, quarterly budget followed by adequate financial reporting 
•	Arranged weekly meetings and administrated volunteers to be more engaged in each event

organizations.name: Korean Undergraduate Research group for professional Certification for Kelley
organizations.description:
•	Directed weekly meeting of the organization of 15 members with the executive board to check the progress of research
•	Organized and supervised information sessions and education sessions to share research and speech skills with all members
•	Assigned daily operations of team members with encouragement and managed conflicts between members
•	Built different efficient marketing strategies and implemented into online platforms and offline environment										   
•	Researched and analyzed professional certifications in diverse fields to share the information to college students
•	Established data visualization and developed a database and infographic based on certification data collected

organizations.name: Innovative Idea Tank Club
organizations.description:
•	Consulted EventsLogBook.com to propose implementation and improvement in the area of HTML and CSS 
•	Generated revenue increment of 2% and structured a website to maximize the accessibility of users
•	Participated in Cheng Wu Innovation Challenge and developed an idea for magnetic rehabilitation technology
